_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

rigs_now.basis: automated rigs in operation, October 30th, 2026 call

share_next_pct.basis: about this percent of the Permian fleet next year

share_2028.basis: approximately half of the Permian fleet by 2028, as a fraction

fleet_aug_floor.basis: more than this many Permian rigs, Reuters, August; a floor, never a count

auto_aug.basis: automated rigs at the time of the August report

pipe_lb.basis: roughly this many pounds per tall steel pipe

pipe_kg.basis: computed, pounds to kg, nearest 10 kg; drawing mass only, never printed

lateral_miles.basis: miles drilled horizontally by the first automated rig

lateral_m.basis: computed, miles to metres; drawing only, never printed

days_floor.basis: a little over this many days

rank_fastest.basis: the third fastest time in Exxon's history

injury_share.basis: about a third of significant injuries happen on the rig floor

incident_potential.basis: stated POTENTIAL, roughly one-third of high-consequence incidents; never a result

hp_added.basis: additional FlexRobotics systems over the next 12 months

hp_total.basis: FlexRobotics systems operating for ExxonMobil after the expansion

technologies_floor.basis: more than this many technologies in the Permian

goal_mboe.basis: approximately this many million oil-equivalent barrels a day

goal_year.basis: the year of the production goal

rack_unit.basis: drawing unit, a choice: one rack of 20 joints stands for the Permian fleet; never printed

rack_next.basis: computed: share_next_pct of rack_unit, nearest joint

joint_m.basis: drawing choice, Range 2 joint length in metres; never printed

stand_m.basis: computed: a triple stand of joint_m joints; drawing only

injury_floor_tiles.basis: drawing choice: the floor as nine plates; never printed

injury_tiles.basis: computed: injury_share of the nine plates
